Welcome to Jump To Steal Basketball Players!

🎟️NEW CODE: WELCOME 🎁✨

💡 Get Lucky Blocks back to your base without getting caught to unlock new Basketball Players!
💵 Use the cash your Basketball Players earn to upgrade your character and build a better base!
⏰ Your Basketball Players earn cash even while you're offline! Come back daily to collect your earnings!

Having fun? Give the game a Like and join our group for surprises and upcoming updates! ☺️
